title: 212. N-Queens II

examples.explanation: There are two distinct solutions to the 4-queens puzzle.
There is one distinct solution to the 1-queens puzzle.

hints: Place one queen per row: a new queen is valid only when its column, diagonal, and anti-diagonal are all free.
Columns are tracked by index, diagonals by `row - col` (shifted), and anti-diagonals by `row + col`; when all n rows are filled, the placement is a solution.
